_meta.title: News page editorial bar + localized copy
_meta.description: Editorial contract for the /news page generated from consuming decaf-ts GitHub releases (scripts/collect-data.cjs -> src/assets/data/news.json). Provides the readable item shape, excerpt rules for thin/empty release bodies, the repo roster to consume, and the localized section/nav copy (en+pt) the FE lifts into i18n.
_meta.note: GitHub release bodies in this org are frequently just the version string; the excerpt rule below falls back to the module summary so no item renders empty.

itemShape.id: stable string key: `<repo>@<tag>` (the releases API has no id that survives a re-fetch order change)
itemShape.title: release `name` when meaningful, else `<module> <tag>`
itemShape.tag: `tag_name` with a single leading `v` stripped, e.g. `0.31.2`
itemShape.date: ISO-8601 UTC from `published_at`; render with the locale date pipe
itemShape.prerelease: boolean from the releases API; render a `pre` chip and sort below stable releases
itemShape.excerpt: first readable paragraph of `body` (markdown-stripped, whitespace-collapsed); when the body is empty or only repeats the version, fall back to the module one-line summary from modules.json
itemShape.url: `html_url` (the release page) so the item is actionable

editorialRules.sort: published_at descending, stable releases before prereleases within the same day
editorialRules.grouping: group by repo, newest first; render the repo name as the item tag
editorialRules.emptyBodyFallback: Use the module summary from src/assets/data/modules.json, prefixed with `Release <tag> - `.
editorialRules.dedupe: one item per (repo, tag); never render a release twice when several repos share a version number.
editorialRules.never: Never render an empty card: every item needs title, tag, date, repo and a non-empty excerpt.

news.subtitle.en: Release notes and changelogs from the decaf-ts module family, in one place.
news.subtitle.pt: Notas de versão e changelogs da família de módulos decaf-ts, em um só lugar.

news.empty.en: No releases yet. Check back soon.
news.empty.pt: Ainda não há releases. Volte em breve.

news.error.en: Could not load releases right now. See the GitHub repository for the latest.
news.error.pt: Não foi possível carregar os releases agora. Veja o repositório no GitHub para as novidades.
